sections.title: Linking past triumphs to present traditions
sections.content: Hungarian historical memory uses temporal and commemorative markers like *azóta* (ever since then), *emlékére* (in memory of him/it), and *tiszteletére* (in honor of him/it) to connect medieval events with national symbols such as the midday bell.

items.spanish: A hagyomány szerint a déli harangszó azóta hirdeti a nándorfehérvári győzelmet.
items.english: According to tradition, the noon bell has proclaimed the Belgrade victory ever since.

items.spanish: Hunyadi János tiszteletére sok magyar városban szobrot állítottak.
items.english: Statues were put up in many Hungarian towns in honour of János Hunyadi.

items.spanish: A hagyomány szerint a déli harangszó a védők emlékére szól.
items.english: According to tradition, the noon bell rings in memory of the defenders.
